title: List SubFixer and Stayfile on two free software directories (about 20 minutes, $0)
body:
Both sites are indexed but rank for nothing yet, because no other site links to them. Two free directories fit and need a person's account, so I can't do this myself.

**1. AlternativeTo (free account at https://alternativeto.net)**
Sign up, then use "Add an app" twice.

- SubFixer: URL https://subfixer.app. Category: video / subtitle tools. Platform: Web (online). License: Free. Add it as an alternative to Subtitle Edit and Aegisub. Description: "Fix subtitle files in the browser: convert SRT, VTT, ASS, SBV and more, shift or stretch timing, fix encoding and frame rate. Files stay on your device."
- Stayfile: URL https://stayfile.app. Platform: Web (online). License: Free. Add it as an alternative to iLovePDF and Convertio. Description: "Free PDF, image and spreadsheet tools that run in your browser: merge and split PDFs, convert HEIC, WebP and AVIF, CSV to Excel and back. Nothing is uploaded." If you see the user list "Best 100% Private, Client-Side Web Utilities (Zero Cloud Uploads)", suggest Stayfile for it.

**2. VideoHelp (SubFixer only)**
Open https://www.videohelp.com/software/sections/subtitle and use the site's submit-software link (it may ask for an account or an email). Name: SubFixer. Homepage: https://subfixer.app. Type: online tool, free. Same description as above.

Don't post anywhere else and don't pay for any listing.

**Cost:** $0. **Unlocks:** the first outside links to both sites, which is what Google is waiting for. **Expected return (a guess):** 10 to 50 visits a month from the listings themselves, and faster ranking for the 20+ problem guides the crews are shipping this week. Both sites need 300 visits in 30 days before ads pay anything.

When done, comment "done" here; nothing else is needed from you.
